description: Evaluates eight anonymous founder answers, persists a versioned Buildability Report, and returns an idempotent completed result.
migrationNotes: Run Confect codegen before wiring generated refs.
Persists evaluationSessions, evaluationAnswers, evaluationReports, and evaluationReportVersions.
Access tokens are stored only as SHA-256 hashes; private answers must never enter analytics or public share records.
